- When sentiment is high (≥0.67) and forecast spikes sharply, reduce overshoot by 20–40% in next 5–7 days.  
- If sentiment is low (≤0.33) and forecast is high, apply mean reversion: subtract 10–25% of forecast from next 3–5 days.  
- Avoid overreacting to recent sentiment swings: if sentiment flips within 3 days, adjust forecast by 15–30% toward prior 10-day average.  
- For 30-day horizon, if forecast exceeds true outcome by >1.5x in early days (e.g., day 1–5), cap growth at 1.2x historical max.  
- If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) and forecast is consistently high, apply downward bias correction by 5–15% for days 10–20.  
- If sentiment is negative (≤0.33) and forecast is low, avoid underestimating volatility: add 5–10% to forecast for days 15–25.
